draggable_lists.config.title: Draggable Lists Config
draggable_lists.config.disable_resource_: Hides the up/down arrows on resource pack entries. Dragging replaces them.
draggable_lists.config.disable_server_ar: Hides the up/down arrows on server list entries. Dragging replaces them.
draggable_lists.config.resource_pack_dra: Allows dragging resource pack entries to reorder them.
draggable_lists.config.server_dragging.t: Allows dragging server entries to reorder them.
